_header: Preset qwen36-q4_k_m (MTP text-only, UD-Q4_K_M). Copy next to your install. 4 EDITS, every path absolute:
1. "exe": your engine exe (engine-hyper\hyper.exe inside your install folder).
2. "args" "--model": your MTP UD-Q4_K_M .gguf file. Keep "--max-context" 131072, "--kv" q4_0, "--draft-kv" q4_0.
3. "cwd" + "tokenizer" + "log": your install folder, packs-dir tokenizer, and log path.
4. No "vision" block on this preset (text only). Start it with run-qwen36-q4_k_m.bat; proof: http://127.0.0.1:8080/health says loaded:true.
